scope: Structural cache evidence from retained BF16 records; no new timing conclusion
source_timing_status: Excluded because the completed run overlapped Mac sleep
mechanism: cache_prompt enables common-prefix state reuse and checkpoint restoration; the source creates a checkpoint four tokens before the prompt end and recomputes completion probabilities
mechanism_limit: The four evaluated tokens are observed. The exact executed checkpoint branch is inferred from matching source, without server branch instrumentation.
uzu_prior_mechanism: Every score_next_token call creates fresh state and prefills the complete prompt
uzu_new_mechanism: Opt-in single-entry reuse of the last full f32 vocabulary logits for exact consecutive token and context equality, followed by unchanged current-request readout
